issues.description: The problem statement and solution expect a function named create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate, but the template defines a function named create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate. This name mismatch in the template will confuse students (the header/docs mention create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate) and prevent them from running or testing code that relies on the expected API.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template's function create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate to create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate (and update any internal references), or add a thin wrapper/alias create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate that calls create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate. Also ensure the header/docs in the template match the actual function name so the API is consistent with the problem statement and solution.
